avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces diltiazem levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if needed, monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases diltiazem levels and hypotension risk

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Calcium Supplements
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high doses (>1000mg/day); maintain adequate but modest intake

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive cardiovascular effects; potential for enhanced hypotension
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; inform prescriber if using

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate hypotensive effects of diltiazem
caution_supplements.action: Use moderate doses; monitor for dizziness or weakness

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases diltiazem plasma concentration and hypotension risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; substitute with other citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-sodium Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium may counteract diltiazem's antihypertensive effects
caution_foods.action: Maintain DASH diet; limit sodium intake to <2300mg/day

caution_foods.name: Licorice
caution_foods.mechanism: May cause sodium retention and potassium loss, reducing antihypertensive benefit

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and signs of excessive hypotension (dizziness, fatigue). Screen for CYP3A4 inhibitor interactions that may significantly elevate diltiazem levels and adverse effects.
